officialText:
Section 800.25 – Revise Section 800.25 to read as follows:

800.25 Abandoned Cables, Power Sources & Other Associated Equipment. The accessible portion of abandoned cables, power sources, and other associated equipment shall be removed. Power sources and other special equipment tagged for future use shall be de-energized. Where cables are identified for future use with a tag, such tag shall be of sufficient durability to withstand the environment involved.
